version.author: ZaurS2001
version.changelog: - Fixed final stuck note issue when changing Gate Length to 100% (Added 1-sample safety gap to prevent NOTE_OFF/NOTE_ON collision). (v1.9.6) - Re-engineered active note array parsing to be 100% bulletproof under heavy slider automation.

version.author: ZaurS2001
version.changelog: - Fixed note labels disappearing on short 1/16th notes (Removed strict text width bounding box). (v2.0.1) - Fixed "Off the grid" issue: Sync mode now ties to REAPER's native beat_position. - Fixed flickering on Virtual Keyboard and Timeline via thread-safe array snapshotting. - Fixed hanging notes on FX Bypass (Added CC 123 All Notes Off panic blast on un-bypass).

version.author: ZaurS2001
version.changelog: - CRITICAL FIX: Rewrote Sync Engine to an absolute "Integer Grid Tracker". Flawlessly triggers the exact microsecond transport starts. (v1.6.3) - Fixed "First note muted" bug (Removed internal CC 123 race condition, again...). - Fixed visualizer "Ghost Notes" by instantly flushing the buffer on transport loops and timeline clicks.

version.author: ZaurS2001
version.changelog: - CRITICAL FIX: Fixed "Free Mode" Phase Burst bug. Dragging the Free Rate slider no longer spawns massive overlapping vomit chords. (v1.6.4) - CRITICAL FIX: Visualizer now mirrors the audio choke engine. Choked notes are visually truncated instantly, eliminating stacking/ghosting. - Fixed overhangs: Notes now clip flawlessly to the playhead line upon transport stop.
